query: I have a 48-year-old female patient to evaluate. Among female Medicare patients aged 43–53 admitted from the emergency department with a principal diagnosis of bowel obstruction, how many completed index admissions were identified in this cohort in the dataset?
final_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.hadm_id) AS num_admissions FROM admissions a JOIN patients p ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id JOIN diagnoses_icd d ON a.subject_id = d.subject_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND p.anchor_age = 48 AND p.insurance = 'Medicare' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.admittime) BETWEEN 2015 AND 2016 AND d.icd_code = 'BO' AND d.icd_version = 'ICD-9';
